Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.513 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B Ipc &
Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Motipur, District Bahraich.

entities.text: D.P. Act, P.S. Motipur, District Bahraich
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  The FIR in question was lodged alleging that daughter of the informant was married to the applicant on 11.03.2023 and sufficient dowry was also given, however, the entire matrimonial family used to harass her and on 28.08.2023 information was received that she has died.

The cause of death could not be ascertained in the postmortem report, however, in the FSL report, Chlorphyrifos Insecticide was found which was the cause of death; no injury was observed on the body of the victim.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argues that two witnesses have already been examined and in the cross-examination, they have not supported the prosecution story.
The applicant is husband and is in custody since 31.03.2024.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
6. Considering the postmortem report and the subsequent statement of the two witnesses not supporting the prosecution, the applicant who has no criminal history is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Ramu be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
